choices.why: No candidate is green velvet, so the deep charcoal rolled-arm three-seater is the closest match: it has the dark, rich tone you asked for and black turned legs that echo the dark mantel.
A pair of nailhead wingback chairs facing each other is the most classic and elegant choice beside a period fireplace, and their light linen balances the dark sofa.
This large traditional medallion rug is big enough to anchor the whole seating group, and its charcoal and cream palette ties the sofa and chairs together.
This dark espresso wood table with an X-base suits the sofa's length and the room's traditional character.
At about 1 m wide, this champagne-gold framed mirror fills the chimney breast and adds a refined accent to the dark mantel.
The turned-column floor lamp with a linen drum shade has the classic feel the room needs and matches the chairs' linen.

answer.why: None of the catalog sofas comes in green velvet, so the deep charcoal sofa stands in for it. Together with dark wood and black legs, it echoes the fireplace, while the linen wingbacks, cream-and-charcoal medallion rug, gold mirror and linen lamp add warmth and classic elegance against the pale period walls and moldings.
